[spoiler=Spartak Otvragivod are the Wellassona Premier League Champions!]
[i]Wellassonan National News - Новеллсти Нациоьнлыы Веласоньый. Wedensday, 3 May 2028[/i]

In a thrilling end to the season, Spartak Otvragivod have been crowned champions of the 2027-28 Wellassonan Premier League. This is Spartak's 24th title overall, as well as their 3rd consecutive title.

With 82 points, they didn't win as much points as last season. However, they did win by a greater margin. In second place was Spartak's local rivals, CSKA Otvragivod. At the halfway point, CSKA stood 1st on the table, two points ahead of Spartak. Nevertheless, poorer results in the latter half of the season caused them to slip behind Spartak, finishing 6 points behind the champions. While an improvement over their 5th place finish from last season, it was a disappointing result given the strong first half of the season.

Matching their previous 3rd place finish last season was Faktchel Yandsleyovsk, ending up with 71 points. In 4th place, with 70 points was Zefhir Sankt-Elenaston. This season was rather poor by their standards; they finished with 14 less points than the 2026-27 season. With their season marked by injuries, they were unable to finish in a strong position, leaving many fans unhappy with the results.

Lower on the table, the race for 5th place was noticeably close. There were multiple teams that fought hard for this position. In the end, 5th place was won by FK Elena, beating out Guevoners Borombov by goal difference, with both teams finishing with 66 points. Dynamo Otvragivod finished 7th with 64 points, and Al-Pudar and VMSK Otvragivod finished 8th and 9th, both with 62 points (Al-Pudar had a better goal difference)

The relegation battle was perhaps over before the 2nd half of the season began. Fk Doya, Kojoty Sosokan, and Avtomotiv Yandsleyovsk were all poor from the start, and finished with 32, 31, and 23 points respectively. Doya were relegated after a solitary season in the top flight. Kojoty were relegated 2 seasons after being first promoted, after narrowly dodging relegation by just 1 point last season. Avtomotiv Yandsleyovsk, a regular in the Premier League, were relegated after 13 seasons, making it the first season since the 2014-15 season in which Yandsleyovsk will be represented by only one team. Their 23 point finish also marks their worst-ever finish in a Wellassonan Premier League season.

The three promoted teams from the Wellassonan Challenge league are FK Fergecko, Metallurgičeskyy Čapadolsk, and Torepdo Sibabna. Fergecko swiftly return to the Premier league after just 1 season in the Challenge League, being promoted as champions. Metallurgičeskyy Čapadolsk return to the Premier league by finishing in 2nd place, securing a spot in the league after 12 consecutive seasons in the Challenge League. Torpedo Sibabna, on the other hand, made history. They are one of only 3 professional football teams form the state of Torkamy, and their promotion marks the first time since the 1958-59 season in which the state is represented in any top level sports league in the country. They finished 5th overall, and won the play-off finals after winning 2-0 against heavy favourites and arch-rivals Dynamo Perrovo.

[b]Yzakastan: Referendum[/b]

It was one day before the war powers resolution was to be voted on nationally, Cahit had spent the morning on the phone with legislators and the governors, the shah had met a delegation from the Qajar realms, and Edis had been working on a new bill to expand the armed forces procurement budget.

The shah had invited the three of them to lunch once again, a matter which Cahit was most certainly grateful for after having to have his wheelchair put back upright after he had hurled a slipper at the minister of energy for suggesting that PETROX membership would damage Yzakastans ability to provide oil for itself.

Gentlemen, intoned the shah as he watched Cahit roll up to the familiar table, which was laid out with tea and pastries once mode.

Your honour, replied Cahit, bowing his head.

Indeed, replied Edis, straightening his chair.

The papers are predicting a 76% turnout of voters for this war powers resolution, began the shah, Highest turnout in five years, 

That is admirable, intoned Cahit, It means that people have their heads on right, unlike our energy minister, he burbled.

What happened with the energy minister? Asked Edis, realising he had made a mistake in asking.

Well gentlemen, he threatened our nation, he threatened our security, said Cahit in a grave jiggling tone.

Did he? What did he do? Asked the shah, amused.

He criticized our joining PETROX, replied Cahit covering his face dramatically and looking away, It was shameful,

Silly man, replied Edis, I never really liked him to be honest, why did you ever pick him? He asked the shah.

He was a moderate, replied the shah between a bite of a pastry.

Key word Edis, moderate, chortled Cahit, Nevertheless, he got sorted out, he chortled again as he bit into a cherry tart.

I assume well be hearing about how he was sorted out in the papers tomorrow, smirked the shah.

Yes, said Cahit pleased with himself, Yes we will,

Very good, now, I heard Itzak is in Wuloosya, said the shah.

Yes, he is, unfortunately he wanted to go there instead of the emirate, frowned Cahit, I fear the bad decisions of their government will rub off on him, 

Hah laughed Edis, Very nice Cahit, 

The shah raised both eyebrows, I agree there Cahit, the fact that they are still our allies, it is a miracle, 

If the war continues, they wont be, Cahit replied, The legislature is beginning to ask questions,

Yes, there are many Senators concerned about the markets, replied Edis.

Speaking of markets, olive yield this year is up, motioned Cahit.

Thatll be good, replied the shah.

Yes, yes, the markets will be overflowing, replied Cahit.

Euh, Cahitdid you hear about those rolling desks that came out this year, they go up and down, asked Edis.

Yes, I am familiar with them, my assistant has one, marvellous thing, I might have to get one, replied Cahit, dabbing his lips.

Ey, Cahit, how are negotiations with the Qajar? Over oil drilling rights, asked the shah.

They are going well, we should be able to do more once the results from the referendum are out, Cahit replied.

Excellent, nodded the shah.

[i]The Amaryllis Times - Der Amaryllis Zette. Saturday, March 25th 2028[/i]

The people greeted the Arelian 4th Fleet this morning, as it arrived in Port Clipton today. 
As dawn broke, the US Dreadnought and the US Steadfast celebrated their arrival with a gun salute, reverberating through the city and the waves.  

In a surprise for all, a surprise guest appearance in the form of President William Manor took the populace by storm. But this will raise questions at home about how the President managed this disappearing performance.

President Manor has stated he will be staying and making visits all across the territory and around the Capital, covering the itinerary for the next week. In the interim, Vice President Banner will be covering on his behalf.

But where all attention will be focused on will be tonights schedule, which has yet to be specified.
